name: Improve Organ SOULs
description: Evidence-driven improvement of organ behavioral instructions — cortex decisions, prefrontal plans, motor execution, cerebellum verification.

steps.title: Measure organ performance
steps.description: Read last 20 mission work trees. Measure per organ: cortex replan rate, prefrontal checkpoint count, motor skill-miss rate, cerebellum false-positive rate. Identify worst organ.
steps.accept_criteria: Per-organ metrics with mission evidence. Worst organ identified.

steps.title: Diagnose and fix SOUL rule
steps.description: Read the failing organ's SOUL.md and SOUL_APPEND. Identify the rule producing bad behavior. Draft update: each change ties to observed failure, includes denial rules for the failure pattern. Verify: no tool syntax in SOUL (B-17), no daemon bypass instructions.
steps.accept_criteria: Updated SOUL with diff. Each change tied to evidence. No tool syntax.

steps.title: Verify on live fleet
steps.description: Deploy SOUL change. Send 3 test missions exercising the changed behavior. Re-measure the failing metric. Compare before/after.
steps.accept_criteria: Target metric improved. No regression on other organs.
